audit_findings.title: Owner earnings may omit material cash reinvestment in deferred commissions
audit_findings.magnitude: $101 million FY2026 net balance increase, equal to 9.1% of the $1,115.3 million anchor; if applied to the anchor, approximately $5.71-$7.53 per share across the modeled scenarios
audit_findings.mechanism: Uncaptured net additions to deferred commissions overstate OE and therefore every forecast year and terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: We capitalize sales commissions that are incremental direct costs of obtaining customer contracts for which revenue is not immediately recognized and classify them as current or non-current based on the terms of the related contracts.
audit_findings.explanation: The $101 million reinvestment is filed and large enough to affect the valuation materially. The error itself is not yet demonstrated because the supplied record does not show whether OE already captures the cash-flow change. If it does, another deduction would double count it.
audit_findings.action: Trace deferred-commission additions and amortization through every OE year; subtract net additions only where absent, then recompute the trend anchor and all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: The ten-year trend mixes a disposed business despite a null perimeter ruling
audit_findings.magnitude: unquantified; $70 million upfront consideration, $31 million recognized contingent consideration, and $83 million of derecognized net assets do not quantify Spot's historical OE
audit_findings.mechanism: Including Spot in earlier OE but excluding it after disposal can distort the log-trend anchor upward or downward depending on Spot's profits, losses, and reinvestment.
audit_findings.evidence: The smaller increase in fiscal 2026 reflects the loss of revenue from our Spot by NetApp business which we sold in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025.
audit_findings.explanation: The mixed perimeter and null adjustment are demonstrated, but the record does not isolate Spot's historical OE. The direction and materiality therefore cannot be established from sale proceeds, carrying values, or the absence of a material disposal gain.
audit_findings.action: Recast each historical OE year without Spot's revenue, costs, working capital, and acquisition-related reinvestment; exclude disposal proceeds and contingent consideration, then rerun the anchor and scenarios.

audit_findings.title: The FY2026 anchor may precede the full run-rate of recurring component inflation
audit_findings.magnitude: FY2027 first-quarter total gross margin was 70.1% versus 70.7% for FY2026; product gross margin was approximately 54.4% versus 56.1%, while the filing says pricing offset higher costs year over year
audit_findings.mechanism: A sustained margin reduction lowers continuing OE and may invalidate an anchor based on months preceding the higher-cost regime.
audit_findings.evidence: We have experienced increased costs for memory and other components, which have affected our gross margins, and we expect costs will remain elevated, or continue to increase, in the near term.
audit_findings.explanation: Higher component costs are already demonstrated, but achieved pricing supported strong revenue and approximately flat year-over-year product margin in the latest quarter. One quarter, including an extra week and different sales mix, cannot establish the sustainable margin or valuation impact.
audit_findings.action: Normalize the latest quarter for the extra week and mix, compare sequential product margins and realized pricing with current component costs, and rerun OE using the demonstrated run-rate margin.

audit_findings.title: The latest-quarter cash bridge lacks a completed non-operating-liability sweep
audit_findings.magnitude: $106 million DataPelago contingent consideration, $40 million restructuring liability, and $46 million of recorded current and long-term unrecognized-tax-benefit components; aggregate required bridge adjustment unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Discrete pre-common claims not represented in recurring projected OE should reduce the cash bridge, while operating liabilities or amounts already expensed must not be deducted again.
audit_findings.evidence: As of April 24, 2026 , we had $ 68 million of gross unrecognized tax benefits, of which $ 38 million has been recorded in other long-term liabilities and $ 8 million has been recorded in other current liabilities.
audit_findings.explanation: The latest filing demonstrates identifiable claims beyond debt and leases, including the $106 million acquisition consideration liability. The record does not establish which amounts are already reflected in OE, offset by related assets, or properly treated as operating liabilities, so the net bridge error remains unresolved.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile every component of $737 million other current liabilities and $360 million other long-term liabilities; classify acquisition consideration, restructuring, taxes, benefits, litigation, and matched deferred-compensation balances, then rerun the bridge for only nonduplicative pre-common claims.

audit_findings.title: Active patent litigation creates an unbridged, unaccrued claim
audit_findings.mechanism: Damages would reduce the equity bridge; royalties, redesign costs, shipment restrictions, or lost sales would reduce continuing OE and possibly growth.
audit_findings.evidence: No material accrual has been recorded as of April 24, 2026 related to such matters.
audit_findings.explanation: The litigation and absence of a material accrual are demonstrated through July 31, 2026, but neither probability nor a loss range is supplied. Management's present expectation of no material harm does not bound an adverse outcome, so materiality cannot be established.
audit_findings.action: Obtain case-specific post-filing developments and counsel-supported probability and loss ranges; model damages in the bridge and recurring royalty, remediation, or sales effects in a downside OE scenario.

audit_findings.title: The zero stake bridge may omit or mis-capitalize the Lenovo joint venture
audit_findings.magnitude: $98 million carrying amount, equal to approximately $0.47 per diluted share and 0.5% of the $19.246 billion base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: If LNTL economics were purged from OE, a supported stake value belongs in the bridge; if its income remains in OE, adding the stake separately could double count value.
audit_findings.evidence: Other non-current assets as of April 24, 2026 and April 25, 2025 include $ 98 million and $ 92 million, respectively, for our 49 % non-controlling equity interest in Lenovo NetApp Technology Limited (LNTL), a China-based entity that we formed with Lenovo (Beijing) Information Technology Ltd. in fiscal 2019.
audit_findings.explanation: The zero stake bridge is inconsistent with the disclosed investment, but omission versus double counting is unresolved. Even adding the entire filed carrying amount would increase base value only from $91.47 to about $91.94 per share and would not alter the valuation conclusion relative to the $185.59 market price.
audit_findings.action: Trace LNTL equity-method income, losses, and distributions through OE and document the treatment; add a separately supported stake value only if those economics were purged.
